data.name: Avish
data.long_meaning: Avish is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘विश्व’ (Vishv) which means ‘all, universally’. The prefix ‘अव-’ (Av-) means ‘God’ or ‘Lord’, so Avish means ‘God is abundant’. In Hindu mythology, Avish is a name of Lord Vishnu.
